title: samseg
description: SAMSEG (Statistical and Algorithmic Methods for Segmentation) is a tool for segmenting neuroimaging data.

input_files.description: Input image files, must be in registration with each other.
input_files.title: Input files

t1w_files.description: T1-weighted input file, causes input to be conformed unless --hires is used.
t1w_files.title: T1-weighted files

other_modality_files.description: Specific mode input files, each associated with a custom modality name.
other_modality_files.title: Other modality files

output_directory.description: Output directory where results will be saved.
output_directory.title: Output directory

options_file.description: JSON file for specifying advanced options.
options_file.title: Options file

dissection_photo_mode.description: Mode for processing 3D reconstructed dissection photos, specifying left/right/both.
dissection_photo_mode.title: Dissection photo mode

save_history.description: Turns on saving of processing history.
save_history.title: Save history flag

subject.description: Subject identifier, sets output directory to subject/mri/samseg. The first input must be the conformed T1 weighted input.
subject.title: Subject

save_probabilities.description: Save posterior, prior, and likelihood as 3-frame volume for each tissue type.
save_probabilities.title: Save probabilities flag

no_mrf.description: Do not perform Markov Random Field processing.
no_mrf.title: No MRF flag

threads.description: Set the number of CPUs to use.
threads.title: Number of threads

atlas_directory.description: Path to the SAMSEG atlas directory.
atlas_directory.title: Atlas directory

no_block_coordinate_descent.description: Do not use block coordinate descent.
no_block_coordinate_descent.title: No block coordinate descent flag

logdomain_costandgradient_calculator.description: Use log-domain cost and gradient calculator.
logdomain_costandgradient_calculator.title: Use logdomain cost and gradient calculator flag

no_logdomain_costandgradient_calculator.description: Do not use log-domain cost and gradient calculator.
no_logdomain_costandgradient_calculator.title: No logdomain cost and gradient calculator flag

fill.description: Use samseg to create filled.mgz instead of recon-all.
fill.title: Fill flag

normalization2.description: Use samseg to create brain.mgz instead of recon-all (with --recon).
normalization2.title: Normalization2 flag

use_t2w.description: Use the T2-weighted input when running recon-all.
use_t2w.title: Use T2w flag

use_flair.description: Use the FLAIR-weighted input when running recon-all.
use_flair.title: Use FLAIR flag

pallidum_separate.description: Move pallidum outside of global white matter class, used for analyzing T2 or FLAIR.
pallidum_separate.title: Pallidum separate flag

lesion_mask_pattern.description: Pattern needed when using T2 for lesion mask, e.g., 0 1.
lesion_mask_pattern.title: Lesion mask pattern

registration_file.description: Registration file (LTA or MAT) as output by samseg.
registration_file.title: Registration file

ssdd_directory.description: Path to SAMSEG_Data_DIR where the atlas is located.
ssdd_directory.title: SSDD directory

save_mesh.description: Save the mesh, useful for longitudinal analysis.
save_mesh.title: Save mesh flag

smooth_wm_cortex.description: Smooth white matter and cortex priors using specified sigma value.
smooth_wm_cortex.title: Smooth WM cortex

profile_file.description: Run using the cProfile Python profiler, with the specified profile file.
profile_file.title: Profile file
